title: 第38章 生死历练第39章 蛮狠强者
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
南宫秋月被赵宇看得有些不好意思了，她本来就是要告诉赵宇的，不过是女孩子特有的心性，耍一下小性子而已。
她现在经常性的想着轻微地捉弄一下赵宇，但，若是赵宇反应错了，不高兴了她就会马上改回来。
南宫秋月就把她这次出来历练的事情整个过程给赵宇说了个遍。
原来这次离开宗门出来历练，是有一位王者境的护卫一路陪着她的，那是一位从小就跟着她的护道之人，姓陈，在南宫家族中，都称她“陈妈”
这三个月的历练结果也很好，她的武道境界已从脱俗六重跨入了超凡境一重，实战技能也大为提高。
就在前几天，她们游历到浮云山脉一个更深的区域，发现有远处宝光四起，直冲云霄，修武之人均知道，这等宝光直冲之地，一定有重宝出现，
陈妈带着她赶了过去，一到那里，发现大批武者蜂拥而来。
一般都是高阶超凡境，也有好多位王者境武者，至于脱俗境和低阶超凡境就很少了。
这块显现重宝的地方却是凶险异常，就在外围的地方都有许多的灵阵，开始就有几位高阶超凡境武者欲闯入进去，结果都被灵阵绞杀。
所以陈妈担心南宫秋月进入其间风险太大，有可能会有陨落的可能，就让南宫秋月呆在外面，随便找一些机缘，又留给了南宫秋月一些护身符，自己则与其他人准备闯入其间，寻找更大的机缘，还希望能得到一些重宝。
南宫秋月还拒绝了一位想和她共同历练的年轻武者，一句话内心不喜欢那油头粉面、装腔作势的青年。
一个人开始在外围寻找机缘。
就在历练途中，却碰到一只年轻妖猿，那只妖猿正处于性冲动期。
一看娇嫩美艳的南宫秋月，立刻骚性狂发，想把南宫秋月虏走，进行交配。
在妖兽世界，大部分妖兽只喜欢猎杀人类武者，当然它们也猎杀其他妖兽。
只有妖猴、妖猿特别是年轻的猿类由于性欲旺盛，喜欢抢掠雌性同类，也包括女性人类。
特别女性人类，由于体质差异，经常在性交过程中被它们折磨至死，而妖兽更残忍的是，会把那些被虐毙的女性人类撕烂吃掉。
所以落在它们手里，那就是生不如死，还需要承受无法忍受的屈辱。
当然的结果是一人一兽生死搏杀。
一开始那妖猿因为要捕捉南宫秋月，下手还留手了，可南宫秋月看着那妖猿的丑恶模样，狂怒不已，一开始就痛下杀手。

把家传的“飘凌剑法”
发挥得淋漓尽致，没多一会就把那妖猿杀得遍体是伤。
那妖猿眼见生命危急，发出阵阵怪叫，就一会就过来两头更大更强的妖猿。
原来那年轻妖猿把它父母唤了过来。
那两只妖猿已是四阶妖兽，是可比人类王者境的修为了。
那两只妖猿一看儿子被人伤成这样，便狂暴无比，就想一掌拍死南宫秋月。
可那只年轻的妖猿对着它父母一阵比划，意思让它父母别杀南宫秋月，活捉回去，它还想要交配，至于它受的伤，由于妖兽的体质特异，不过一二天就好了。
南宫秋月顿时大感惶恐，她大概已经知道了妖兽的用意。
便不再多想，赶忙拿出护身符捏碎击发，慌忙逃窜，好在护身符中有遁身符，助她快速遁身，但那两只妖猿仍紧追不舍。
content_en:
Nangong Qiuyue felt a little embarrassed by Zhao Yu. She originally wanted to tell Zhao Yu, but it was just a girl's unique temperament and she was just playing a little bit.
She now often thinks about teasing Zhao Yu slightly, but if Zhao Yu reacts wrongly and becomes unhappy, she will change it right away.
Nangong Qiuyue told Zhao Yu the whole process of her coming out for training.
It turns out that this time she left the sect for training, she was accompanied by a king-level guard. She was a protector who had been with her since she was a child. Her surname was Chen. In the Nangong family, they all called her "Mother Chen"
The results of these three months of training are also very good. Her martial arts realm has moved from the sixth level of the secular realm to the first level of the extraordinary realm, and her actual combat skills have also been greatly improved.
Just a few days ago, they traveled to a deeper area in the Fuyun Mountains and discovered that there were precious lights in the distance, soaring into the sky. Everyone who practices martial arts knows that where these precious lights are so direct, there must be important treasures.
Chen Ma took her there and rushed there. When she got there, she found a large number of warriors swarming in.
They are generally in the high-level extraordinary realm, and there are many king-level warriors. As for the transcendent realm and the low-level extraordinary realm, there are very few.
This place where the treasure appears is extremely dangerous. There are many spiritual formations just outside. At first, several high-level transcendent realm warriors tried to break in, but they were all strangled by the spiritual formations.
Therefore, Chen Ma was worried that it would be too risky for Nangong Qiuyue to enter, and she might fall. She asked Nangong Qiuyue to stay outside and find some opportunities. She also left some amulets to Nangong Qiuyue, while she and others prepared to break into it, looking for greater opportunities, and hoping to get some valuable treasures.
Nangong Qiuyue also rejected a young warrior who wanted to practice with her. In one word, she didn't like the oily-faced, pretentious young man.
A person begins to look for opportunities on the periphery.
On the way to experience, he met a young demon ape who was in the sexual impulse stage.
As soon as he saw the delicate and beautiful Nangong Qiuyue, he immediately became lustful and wanted to take Nangong Qiuyue away for mating.
In the world of monsters and beasts, most monsters only like to hunt human warriors, but of course they also hunt other monsters.
Only demon monkeys and apes, especially young apes, like to rob female congeners, including female humans, because of their strong sexual desire.
Especially female humans, due to their physical differences, are often tortured to death by them during sexual intercourse. What is even more cruel is that the monsters will tear up and eat the female humans who have been tortured to death.
So if you fall into their hands, life will be worse than death, and you will have to endure unbearable humiliation.
Of course, the result is a life-and-death fight between one man and one beast.
At first, the demon ape held back because he wanted to capture Nangong Qiuyue, but when Nangong Qiuyue saw the ugly appearance of the demon ape, he was furious and killed him from the beginning.
The "Piao Ling Sword Technique" passed down from the family
He used it to his fullest, and within a short time, he killed the demonic ape with wounds all over his body.
Seeing that its life was in danger, the demon ape let out strange screams, and soon two larger and stronger demon apes came over.
It turned out that the young demon ape called his parents over.
The two demonic apes were already fourth-level demonic beasts, with cultivation levels comparable to those of human kings.
When the two monster apes saw their son being injured like this, they became extremely furious and wanted to slap Nangong Qiuyue to death.
But the young monster ape made gestures to its parents, telling them not to kill Nangong Qiuyue and capture her alive. It also wanted to mate. As for the injury it suffered, due to the monster's unique physique, it would only heal in a day or two.
Nangong Qiuyue suddenly felt frightened. She probably already knew the intention of the monster.
She stopped thinking about it, quickly took out the amulet, crushed it and fired, and fled in a hurry. Fortunately, there was an escape talisman in the amulet, which helped her escape quickly, but the two monster apes were still chasing after her.
